# konflux-sandbox-onboarding

Guide AIPCC engineers through obtaining access to the shared Konflux sandbox, onboarding a user-selected GitHub repository or dummy project, and verifying pull-request and push pipelines. Use when an engineer wants a hands-on Konflux staging experiment; exclude production tenants and release configuration.

**Plugin**: [odh-konflux](index.md) | **:material-check: User-invocable**

## Usage

```bash
/konflux-sandbox-onboarding
```
